title: Tech Note: Installing and Troubleshooting 4D Server - Windows

historical_commentary.text: This note documents installation and troubleshooting steps for 4D Server and 4D Client V6 specifically on Windows; as OS-specific installer guidance tied to the Windows NT/95-era operating systems and V6-era installer mechanics, it is now purely of historical interest, since 4D Server's installation process, supported Windows versions, and networking stack have all changed substantially over subsequent decades.
related_updates: 4D Server's installation process, licensing, and supported Windows OS versions have changed substantially many times since 1997
Networking transport for 4D Server has shifted from an AppleTalk/TCP-IP-mixed era toward standardized TCP/IP-only networking in later 4D versions
